ios.desc:
Malfi is your private, secure personal finance companion. Track your complete financial picture - from bank accounts and investments to mortgages - all in one beautifully designed app.

YOUR COMPLETE FINANCIAL PICTURE

• Bank Accounts
Track all your accounts across multiple banks. Monitor balances and see your cash position at a glance.

• Stock Portfolio
Add your stock holdings and watch them grow. Real-time prices keep your portfolio value up to date. Support for US and international markets.

• Cryptocurrency
Track Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies. See your holdings in your preferred currency.

• Mortgage Tracker
Stay on top of your home loan. Track remaining balance, see your amortization schedule, and understand exactly where you stand.

MULTI-CURRENCY SUPPORT

Living across borders? Malfi handles it. View your entire portfolio. Exchange rates update automatically so you always know your true net worth.

PRIVACY FIRST

Your financial data is yours alone.

• All data stored locally on your device
• Bank-grade encryption (256-bit)
• Face ID and Touch ID protection
• No accounts to create
• No tracking or analytics
• No ads, ever

SHARE WITH YOUR PARTNER

Optionally share your portfolio with your partner via iCloud. See your combined household finances while keeping your data secure in your private iCloud storage.

DESIGNED FOR iOS

Malfi is built specifically for iPhone with a clean, intuitive interface. Dark mode support, smooth animations, and thoughtful design make managing your finances a pleasure.

FEATURES

• Dashboard with total net worth
• Multiple bank account tracking
• Stock portfolio with real-time prices
• Cryptocurrency tracking
• Mortgage amortization calculator
• Multi-currency support
• Partner portfolio sharing via iCloud
• iCloud sync across your devices
• Face ID / Touch ID protection
• Dark mode support
• Offline access to all your data
• No subscription required

Take control of your finances with Malfi - private, secure, and beautifully simple.
